name: cover_armed
about: The cover record against an ARMED player: the player holds a firearm (item_w_thirtyeight, weapon slot 360 answers 0x2000, conditions-and-states.md 'CapabilitiesGet 0x1026db30'). The cover chooser 0x102b7690's cover tail reads GetEnemy()->+0x9c (the combat-character self-downcast) -> GetActiveWeapon -> vtable +0x5a0 & 0x6000 != 0, so bVar1 = false (a ranged threat); with 0x102b5de0 passing, the gunman not already in 0x9e and COVER_VS_MELEE_MODE clear it answers 0xa3 SCHED_TROIKA_TAKE_COVER_HINT_ATTACK (line 0x5cd9), never 0xa4 _VS_MELEE. sched_troika_take_cover_hint_attack.sch: SET_FAIL_SCHEDULE TAKE_COVER_HINT, SET_NPC_FLAG TASKS_FACE_ENEMY, SNAP_TO_HINT, RESOLVE_BOTCH_IN_COVER, PLAY_COVER_OUTOF, PLAY_COVER_AIM, WAIT_RANDOM 0.5, ANNOUNCE_ATTACK 1, TASK_RANGE_ATTACK1, PLAY_COVER_INTO, PLAY_COVER_IDLE, RESOLVE_BOTCH_IN_COVER, WAIT_ATTACK_TIME1, WAIT_RANDOM 2.0. The pistol is granted by player.armed and wielded by the ranged-category verb (slot3 through the command bus, ElysiumInventorySelect.cpp's Commit -> SetActiveWeapon).
known_red: new: the cover tail never reads the enemy's weapon (ElysiumNpcSchedule.cpp:484-495, stub 'no cross-entity weapon capability reader'): 0xa4 VS_MELEE against a ranged player where retail answers 0xa3
